critique: The render convincingly captures the preset language: pure black background, crisp flat triangular sprites, a clean mint-to-bright-green color progression, and clearly energetic outward motion from t1 to t4. By t4 the field is much broader and individual triangles are mostly readable. It still falls short of the airy thumbnail-style graphic distribution because a few very large triangles remain visually dominant and the central area retains some overlap; the triangle scale variation feels more like a particle burst than an evenly composed 2D triangle field.

suggestions.why: Reducing maximum particle size makes the dominant large sprites less distracting and improves separation/readability across the field.
A modest velocity increase carries the now-smaller triangles farther from the center, producing a broader and airier motion-graphics arrangement.
